literal.prompt: При каком императоре началось строительство Транссибирской магистрали?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library states that construction of the Trans-Siberian route began under Alexander III in 1891 (L60); the four labels are Russian emperors and have been put in the prepositional case required by «При каком императоре». The three retained Presidential Library contexts separately support the factual notes about Alexander I (ministries in 1802), Alexander II (Great Reforms and emancipation), and Nicholas I (Third Section in 1826).
literalGroups.locator: PRlib official history: turn1view0 L60-L62 (unique answer/year); PRlib 619554 L44-L46 (Alexander I fact); PRlib 619519 L51-L55 (Alexander II fact); PRlib 619386 L44-L47 (Nicholas I / Third Section date).

literalGroups.literal: При Александре III началось строительство Транссибирской магистрали. Официальное начало строительства относится к 1891 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official Presidential Library page directly dates the start to Alexander III in 1891 and reproduces the emperor's instruction to his heir to announce the construction (L60-L62).

literalGroups.literal: Александр I учредил министерства в России в 1802 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page says that in 1802 Alexander I's manifesto replaced the collegia with eight ministries and then describes his role in their coordination (L44-L46).

literalGroups.literal: Александр II провёл Великие реформы, включая отмену крепостного права.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The biography says Alexander II signed the 1861 emancipation manifesto, was called the Tsar Liberator, and describes his 1861-1874 reforms (L51-L55).

literalGroups.literal: В 1891 году Александр III поручил наследнику объявить о строительстве магистрали.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official page names Alexander III as the emperor under whom the route began and reproduces his instruction to the heir to announce his will to begin building the line (L60-L62).
literalGroups.locator: PRlib official history, turn1view0 L60-L62; the cited 1900 guide is named in line 61 and the instruction is reproduced in lines 61-62.

literalGroups.literal: Николай I создал Третье отделение собственной канцелярии в 1826 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page states that by Nicholas I's decree in 1826 the Special Chancellery became the Third Section of His Imperial Majesty's Own Chancellery (L46).
